interpretation: The frozen H3 decomposition is not explained by stage-specific sample loss, and total genus-adjusted attenuation remains large in the observed direct-only profiles. However, paired spatial-block resampling does not establish a precisely localized positive family-to-genus incremental attenuation: all eight direct-only 95% intervals include zero. The manuscript must therefore distinguish strong taxonomic-composition sensitivity from precise localization of the incremental attenuation at the family-to-genus transition.
claim_boundary: This post-baseline robustness result does not change the historical H3 classification, does not test whether true genus boundaries outperform arbitrary matched-complexity partitions, and does not identify dispersal, evolution or pollinator mechanisms. P1c remains the separate genus-specificity test.
